# Archived HyperFrames recipe skills

These files are an upstream documentation snapshot retained for provenance and
occasional internal reference. They are not active Project Sniper skills.

Project Sniper uses the pinned HyperFrames renderer only to render Producer's
registered motion compositions. It does not advertise or route work to the
upstream music-to-video, PR-to-video, website, slideshow, launch-video, Figma,
or generic composition recipes stored here.

Do not move these directories into `.claude/skills/` or `.agents/skills/` unless
Project Sniper deliberately adopts, integrates, tests, and documents that
workflow as a product capability.
